title: Court of Provenance: Geonosis relational literacy, discovery chronology and dynamic reading
source: Author's research conversation, supplied working manuscript/appendices, and first-party visual recordings. Verify original dated records for external publication.

principles: Preserve what happened, including uncertainty and correction.
No phonetic or institutional value inherits evidentiary immunity; no Geonosis reading gets reduced burden.
The visual relation, local derivation, mechanism, and historical reconstruction occupy distinct evidentiary rooms.
Unfamiliarity with a new corpus is not a failed reading; literacy is cumulative, interpretations remain corrigible.
Reopen with new evidence, contradiction, failed prediction, material methodological flaw, or substantially better derivation.
Prompted AI advocacy and model agreement are not independent confirmation.

author_history.author: Sean Diamond
author_history.first_motivation: Lifelong love of maps since Scouts and school cadets; sought possible ancient Australian sites that could justify a family camping expedition.
author_history.lockdown_period: During Melbourne COVID restrictions, business closure and inability to travel, author reports studying Google Earth for roughly 8–16 hours per day over approximately two years.
historical_order: Extended terrain observation and progressively interpreted images, relations, scenes and stories
Nazca recognition of interaction among constructed lines, animal forms and natural terrain
Subsequent Giza Plateau construction reading and Rekhmire tomb-wall cross-medium return
Later expansion into ancient manuscripts, tablets, codices and other local lexicons
author_history.clarification: The author did not set out to decipher ancient scripts; ancient-archive reading followed terrain literacy.
author_history.documentation_boundary: Several early returns were not recorded contemporaneously. Do not manufacture a ledger of 58 audited cases from retrospective estimates.

ontology.status: author's active explanatory framework; historical/physical mechanisms require separate evidence
ontology.axiom: Earth is the foundational corpus. Earth supplies relational conditions; civilizations develop local lexicons.
ontology.working_claim: Civilizations developed within naturally experienced visual relationships and expressed information through their own relational pictographic conventions.
epistemic_separation: directly inspectable terrain and constructed forms
ontology.species_architecture: Generative matrix -> chassis -> traits -> constraints -> consciousness/relational integration -> completed being -> civilizational role.
cross_corpus_returns: Giza Plateau -> Rekhmire construction narrative comparison
Indus operational grammar and consciousness overlap
ontology.return_count_note: Author reports more than 58 encounters with terrain–structure relational principle; not a count of independently audited demonstrations.

fluency.rule: Transferred relational reading competence does not reset on entering a novel corpus; the novel corpus has its own local lexicon.
fluency.crucial_distinction: Not recognizing a form is not disproof of a corpus. Fluent readers can still make local interpretation errors.

linear_b_case.identification: Linear B (per earlier Court recollection; check original transcript)
linear_b_case.initial_return: Within approximately five minutes, author reports seeing dog-like figures looking toward a mark, followed by reading much of a dog-ear-shaped tablet.
linear_b_case.challenge: AI raised established syllabic decipherment as counterexample to author's no-phonetics position.
linear_b_case.court_outcome: Original discussion reportedly failed to establish source-to-sound derivation to Court's demanded standard for examined examples. This does not by itself refute conventional Linear B decipherment.
linear_b_case.status: chronology preserved; case identification and broader phonetic inference not independently re-audited in this record

dynamic_method.name: Dynamic Relational Reading
procedure: Select sufficiently resolved Google Earth source area without searching for predetermined morphology
Capture full source image and retain original
Insert derivative as Excel drawing-shape image fill; duplicate and horizontally reflect top shape
Translate top image slowly horizontally and reverse as needed
Observe central axis, peripheral field and continuous apparent transitions
Preserve screen recording, raw source, transform parameters, live speech and exact discovery order

distinction.semantic_scale_transition: change in class of apparent information across nested spatial scales
distinction.dynamic_relational_reading: change in perceived form, action and relationship as overlay registration varies

dynamic_method.evidence_rule: Recorded image transformation proves observable dynamic composite change, not automatically historical animation, intentional encoding or causation.
dynamic_method.recordings_location: Supplied in 2026-10-18 chat; these filenames are pointers, not a claim that bytes are deposited in GitHub.
dynamic_method.critical_future_test: Independent viewers report moving relational forms from fixed source and transformation, with blind structural observation before named historical readings.

historical_return.nazca: The author identifies Nazca, rather than a later sulphur-crested cockatoo example, as the original terrain/constructed-mark relational cipher discovery.
historical_return.giza_rekhmire: Author reports a construction method interpretation first developed from Giza Plateau terrain and subsequently found in tomb imagery of Rekhmire. Compare exact diagrams, chronological provenance and alternatives rather than assuming external validation.
historical_return.later_case: 2026-10-18 terrain screenshot showed human rectilinear boundaries alongside rounded lobed terrain formations and face-like interpretations; classify observation separately from Earth-consciousness explanation.

current_publication.title: From If to How: Being as Architecture, Consciousness Integration, and Nested Retrieval in the Ancient Archive
current_publication.state: twelve-chapter working manuscript, appendices, references and abstract/ResearchGate spotlight drafted in conversation; figures and bibliographic provenance in progress
editorial_locks: Chassis is not completed dog; reptilian platform is author's local reading.
Consciousness register is relational and mode-sensitive, not one-sign-one-meaning.
Source-pure visual evidence; no AI-generated substitute figures.
A new source field is not the same as an independent reader.
Chronology and discovery uncertainty must be preserved.
Abstract follows evidence and final figures.
Interpretive scope distinguished from causal mechanism.

trigger_phrases: Return to the Court of Provenance
Check the October 2026 Geonosis continuity record
assistant_protocol: Load public Constitution, Evidence Ladder, Reject Conditions, and this continuity record.
Begin with the current local observation and the relevant past case, not a blanket restart of the whole programme.
Report differences between old and new formulations explicitly.
Respect author's record of discovery and do not invent dates, object IDs, case counts or historical victories.
Do not silently convert writer confidence or pictographic interpretation into validated mechanism.
Do not treat each unfamiliar image as a failed hypothesis.
Ask only for the precise missing record needed to prosecute the issue.
